game: binary 6-cube V_6={0,1}^6, forbidding 7 points on a common real affine hyperplane (degenerate cases included)
claim: K_6 >= 9 (certified witness); upper bound K_6 <= 9 is OPEN

lower_bound.maximality: audit_frontier9.py: all 64 vertices forbidden as a 10th point for this witness

correct_encoding.method: exhaustive enumeration of all C(64,7)=621216192 seven-subsets and UNSAT of the 'exactly 10 chosen' CNF banning every dependent 7-subset

cnf.encoding: one clause (-x_a ... -x_g) per dependent 7-subset; Sinz sequential counters for exactly-10 (at-most-10 over x, at-most-54 over -x)

correct_encoding.state: raw 6.9 GB CNF generated in /tmp; CaDiCaL 1.7.4 OOM on a 19 GB machine; no UNSAT verdict

invalid_circuit_encoding.why_invalid: inclusion-minimal dependent sets (circuits) include dependent 4/5/6-subsets that are legal in the game; banning circuits instead of all dependent 7-subsets is not equivalent (see K0591 lesson 1)
invalid_circuit_encoding.kissat_run: kissat 4.0.4 on certificates/k6_k10_fix0.cnf (4160 vars, 19484943 clauses) terminated by SIGTERM after 8h10m21s; no verdict; partial DRAT is not a proof

dependent_subset_counts.cross_check: every predicate call evaluated modulo 2^61-1 and modulo 1000000007 with independent eliminations; all 621216192 seven-subsets agree

sat_control_exactly_9.geometric_check: verify_k9_witness.py: all C(9,7)=36 seven-subset determinants nonzero (|det| 1..9)
sat_control_exactly_9.meaning: control only; does not validate the circuit reduction

lessons: circuit reduction is invalid for this stone-addition game: minimal forbidden sets are exactly the dependent 7-subsets, because dependencies of fewer points are legal
full-enumeration game solvers must recompute children from the position (any unused safe vertex), never reuse the enumeration path
